title: SmartAttend Release (v1.0.3)
releaseNotes: Update reminders stay dismissed after refreshing or reopening the app.
Fingerprint enrollment now reports when its Firebase backend is unavailable.
Android and iOS face API origins are explicitly allowed.
New attendance sessions default to 45 seconds plus 75 seconds.
Quick attendance preset is now 30 seconds plus 30 seconds.
Modern glassmorphism UI & responsive dark mode styling
Real-time notifications, attendance management, and analytics
Multi-role security (Admin, Faculty, Student) with device verification
Integrated In-App Update system for seamless APK upgrades
